observations: The page number «83» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «11*» on the right. L01 continues the computation of p. 82 (JP2 0114, L30-L34). L01: «Der Mond is also», see the critical note.

L08: «nun ist :» at the left margin, the proportion «6° 15′ 16″ ∶ 34′ 20″1) = 10h 55m 48s» set in the middle of the line after a wide gap; the colon of the division with a word space on either side (25 and 20 px), written ∶ (U+2236); L23 «1 ∶ 13» likewise (21 and 20 px). L15-L17: the two additions, set as a small table, each sum below a rule; «+» before the second figures. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed. L20-L21: the case fractions 1/12 and 13/12, written {cf:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}. L08-L10, L19: the h, m and s raised.

Between L24 and L25 a small figure in the middle of the line, not reproduced: a horizontal line with short upright strokes at its two ends and between them, nearer the right end; the italic letters M, S and K stand above the left end, the inner stroke and the right end; the line is not drawn to the scale of the text (MS about three times SK, where L25-L26 make it twelve times).

L01-L19. Checked: 302° 50′ 56″ − 297° 4′ 32″ = 5° 46′ 24″; its twelfth is 28′ 52″ and 5° 46′ 24″ + 28′ 52″ = 6° 15′ 16″, whose thirteenth is again 28′ 52″; 6° 15′ 16″ : 34′ 20″ = 10.9301 hours = 10h 55m 48s; 7h 48m 41s (p. 82, JP2 0114, L26) + 10h 55m 48s = 18h 44m 29s after noon of 29 Muḥarram, 22 January 901, that is 6h 44m in the morning of 23 January; 302° 50′ 56″ + 28′ 52″ = 297° 4′ 32″ + 6° 15′ 16″ = 303° 19′ 48″. N03: 32′ 56″ : 2′ 28″ = 13.35. N01: with the lunar equation sin q = sin 4° 56′ · sin m and the hourly motion in anomaly of 32′ 40″, the true hourly motion at the anomaly 119° 10′ is about 32′ 56″ + 1′ 22″ = 34′ 18″, near the 34′ 20″ of Table 64.

N02. Checked: Cordova lies 4° 47′ west of Greenwich, 19 minutes of time, so that 6h 43m at Greenwich is 6h 24m at Cordova («c. 5°», 20 minutes, 6h 23m); 6h 44m − 6h 23m = 21m; Antioch lies about 41° east of Cordova, 2h 44m, which on the tables' 6h 44m 29s gives 9h 28m, Suter's 9h 29m with the seconds; 9h 29m − 9h 20m = 9m. Meeus's algorithm gives the true new moon at 7.38h Terrestrial Time on 23 January 901, with a ΔT of about 0.61h: 6h 46m at Greenwich.

N02: «Schrams», «Schram» and «Schiaparelli» spaced; «Kalendariograph. u. chronolog. Tafeln», «Greenwich», «Cordova» and the first «Antiochia» in italics, the second «Antiochia» (N08) upright; «flndet», see the critical note. N02: the A of «(Anomalie)» stands 10 px from the n, where the other letters of the word stand 3-7 px apart; not letter-spaced. L02: «praecessit,», in italics, Suter's form of the Latin «utrum praecesserit» (chapter 31, p. 24, JP2 0056, L10).
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-13 px measured).
